description: This file defines the 'ModuleNode' class within the Twig templating engine, representing a template module node used during template compilation. It includes methods for constructing, compiling, and managing template nodes, including handling inheritance, blocks, macros, and source context.

classes.name: Twig\Node\ModuleNode
classes.description: A final class extending Node that represents a compiled module template node in Twig, responsible for generating PHP code for templates, handling inheritance, blocks, macros, and source context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ModuleNode with various template components like body, parent, blocks, macros, traits, embedded templates, and source context.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index attribute for the node, used for tracking template rendering order or identification.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main compile method that produces PHP code for the template, including template class, constructor, display, and other methods.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Helper method that generates the core PHP class structure for the template.

methods.name: compileGetParent
methods.description: Generates the method for retrieving the parent template if inheritance is used.

methods.name: compileClassHeader
methods.description: Generates the PHP class header including namespace uses and class declaration.

methods.name: compileConstructor
methods.description: Generates the constructor method for the template class, initializing traits, blocks, and parent template if applicable.

methods.name: compileDisplay
methods.description: Generates the core display method which renders the template, handling inheritance and blocks.

methods.name: compileClassFooter
methods.description: Completes the class with closing braces.

methods.name: compileGetTemplateName
methods.description: Generates the method returning the template's name.

methods.name: compileIsTraitable
methods.description: Determines if the template can be used as a trait and generates the corresponding method.

methods.name: compileDebugInfo
methods.description: Generates debugging information for the compiled template.

methods.name: compileGetSourceContext
methods.description: Generates method returning the source context of the template.

methods.name: compileLoadTemplate
methods.description: Helper method for loading traits templates, used internally during template compilation.
